label: Hyperliquid validator vote awards USDH ticker to Native Markets
note: 2025-09-14: Hyperliquid validator vote awarded USDH ticker to Native Markets; contested governance moment for the chain.

label: USDH sunset announced as Coinbase agrees to buy the ticker from Native Markets
note: 2026-05-14: Bridge announced it would cease issuing new USDH from May 19, 2026, except in limited circumstances, after Coinbase agreed to buy the USDH ticker and partnered with Hyperliquid on USDC; Bridge USDH redemptions and USDC conversions are free.
